quests.title: Teach a right turn
quests.ask: Fill in `turn_right()` so that, called on its own, the robot stays on its cell and ends up facing to its right.
quests.nudge: Stand up and try it: how many quarter turns to the left leave you facing right?

quests.title: Round the first corner
quests.ask: Use your new turn to get the robot down the passage to the marked cell.
quests.nudge: Walk it with your finger first: where does the robot face when it reaches the wall?

quests.title: Reach and pick the gem
quests.ask: Carry on from the marked cell to the gem and pick it up.
quests.nudge: At the second corner, which way does the robot need to turn?
